sources.note: Read in full from a JSTOR copy (Presentation/Trial/odum.pdf; archived as research/primary/odum-odum-1955-ecol-monogr.pdf), 28 Oct 2026. Page map: PDF p. n = printed p. 289 + n. Cited: 291 (introduction: “unique opportunity,” civilization sentence), 293 (methods; “orders of magnitude”; acetate boards), 301 (Fig. 9 autoradiogram), 303–9 (chlorophyll method, Codium edule; rotenone and counts), 311 (Fig. 10 pyramid: 703 / 132 / 11 g/m²), 314 (flow method; 24 g/m²/day = 74,300 lb/acre/yr; 120× open water; 2× Rongelap), 316 (Table 17: income 26.0, outgo 24.4 g/m²/day; “a kind of soil”; fallout “200 mi. from Bikini”), 317 (“only 4% apart”; “rough nature”; winter light), 318 (climax; 5.8% efficiency; turnover 12.5), 319 (summary items 9–12, 16–17, 20). Note: the text says 4%, but Table 17’s totals differ by about 6%. The reader shows an eight-page excerpt for class discussion; the full PDF is a JSTOR copy and is not published with the site.

sources.bib: U.S. Atomic Energy Commission. “Excerpts from AEC Semiannual Reports: Eighteenth Semiannual Report, January–June 1955.” Typescript excerpt, report pp. 31, 32, 90. RMI Nuclear Documents (ICAAD), doc. 403440. https://rminucleardocs.icaad.ngo/api/files/1610679705403jdt30tedgt.pdf.
sources.note: Typescript excerpts, PDF p. 1: report p. 31 (“Military Application,” weapons designed from Operation CASTLE results), p. 32 (Operation WIGWAM), and p. 90, the coral reef section (heading and first paragraph largely illegible); PDF p. 2 continues p. 90. Read visually from the scan, 4 Nov 2026; OCR is unreliable. Contains the 74,000 lb glucose/acre/year figure, plant > animal tissue, “not affected by nuclear explosions,” and the invitation to college and university biologists. PDF pp. 3–6 are pages 51–54 of a different printed AEC report on the 1954 Bravo fallout (probably the Sixteenth Semiannual Report, July 1954; not confirmed) and are not used. US government work.
